chunks: And surely your Lord is the Mighty, the Merciful.
ai.seo_question: What are the meanings of Al-Aziz and Al-Rahim in this Quranic verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the juxtaposition of Al-Aziz (The Almighty) and Al-Rahim (The Merciful) highlights the balance between divine justice and grace, assuring the Prophet that his mission is backed by ultimate power yet guided by compassion. This verse, concluding Surah Ash-Shu'ara, reinforces the concept of Tawhid by linking God's sovereignty with His benevolent care for the believers amidst the disbelievers' rejection.
